comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (93.33%) to Hill-Cec3 Activity: active against S-aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC >32-64 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 1-2 uM), P. aeruginos (MIC 1-2 uM). Discovery: this sequence has also been reported in a different paper where the C-terminal G is converted to C-terminal amidation in this sequence. Peptide H4 is active against E. coli ATCC25922 (MIC 1.6 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC700603 (MIC 6.5 uM), A.baumannii ATCC19606 (MIC 6.5 uM), P-aeruginosa CMCC10104(MIC >26 uM), V. parahaemolyticus ATCC17802 (MIC 3.2 uM), E-faecalis ATCC29212 (MIC >26 uM), B. subtilis BNCC109047 (MIC 1.6 uM), S-epidermidis ATCC35984 (MIC >26 uM), S-aureus ATCC6538 (MIC >26 uM), and C-albicans ATCC10231 (MIC > 26 uM) ( Peng et al., 2023).

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (82.22%) to Hill-Cec1 GRAVY: -0.46; Mol W: 4874.591; Mol formula: C219H350N68O58; Mol Ex coeff: 11100. Activity: Active against S-aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC >32-64 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 1-2 uM), P. aeruginos (MIC 2-4 uM). Discovery: A similar sequence (H14) with one additional G (which is converted to C-terminal amidation here) has also been reported in a different paper. Peptide H14 is active against E. coli ATCC25922 (MIC 3.2 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC700603 (MIC 6.5 uM), A.baumannii ATCC19606 (MIC 6.5 uM), P. aeruginosa CMCC10104 (MIC 12.9 uM), V. parahaemolyticus ATCC17802 (MIC 3.2 uM), E-faecalis ATCC29212 (MIC >25.9 uM), B. subtilis BNCC109047 (MIC 1.6 uM), S-epidermidis ATCC35984 (MIC >25.9 uM), S-aureus ATCC6538 (MIC >25.9 uM), and C-albicans ATCC10231 (MIC > 25.9 uM) ( Peng et al., 2023). comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (84.09%) to Hill-Cec1 GRAVY: -0.27; Mol W: 4670.398; Mol formula: C210H341N64O56; Mol Ex coeff: 5550. Activity: Active against S-aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC >32-64 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 0.5-1 uM), P. aeruginos (MIC 16-32 uM).
